extension.summary: Simkl scrobbler: real-time tracking, watched marks and history import
Simkl scrobbler: real-time tracking, watched marks and history import
extension.description:
Tracks what you watch in Kodi on Simkl.com in real time: movies, TV shows and anime are marked as watched when a playback ends, where you paused is kept as a resume point, and the watched marks you make in the Kodi library are mirrored. Your Simkl history can be imported into the Kodi library, by hand or on a schedule, and resume positions from other Simkl apps can be picked up as well. Sign up at https://simkl.com to:
- Automatically track what you're watching. - Receive notifications about new episodes. - Find recommendations based on your watch history. - See your friends' ratings.

extension.news: v4.0.0 (26-10-26) - new sign-in with a code on simkl.com/pin or a QR code for the phone; existing logins keep working, reconnect from the settings - real-time tracking: start, pause and stop as they happen, position kept on Simkl when you stop early - watched marks made in the Kodi library are mirrored on Simkl - sync from Simkl into the Kodi library (watched marks, by hand or on a schedule; optional resume positions) - rewatch logging for Simkl Pro or VIP accounts - Simkl entry in the context menu: mark, remove from history, Plan to watch, rate, sync updates - ratings: a prompt after a movie (optional), ratings set in Kodi go to Simkl - unsent watches are kept and sent later - exclusions, trailers and clips skipped, specials fixed, no more title guesses (YouTube) v3.2.4 (04-11-25) - fixed bubble recursive call
